name: geoffcanyon
tagline: Product, code, puzzles, and whatever else won't fit in a PRD.
bio: I build AI-powered investment research tools at Arch Labs. Before that: chat design at LivePerson, experimentation tooling at Agoda, community systems at Answers.com, and a decade of building systems at HBO. This is where I write about product, code, puzzles, and fiction. There's nothing I enjoy more than brainstorming — if you have an interesting challenge to tackle, I'd love to hear about it.
status: Currently: building a challenging puzzle game called Lightyard · writing a sequel to my recent novella · prototyping an educational reading app.

jobs.line: Took Arch Investment Research (AIR) from zero to launch: AI that reads complex investment documents, extracts the facts, and automates the busywork around them. Also launched the product API and grew it to broad adoption.
Launched a BERT model: lifted entity-recognition F1 by 34 points.

jobs.about: Southeast Asia's largest online travel agency
jobs.line: Built and tested a trip insurance prototype. Launched the company's first personalization tool. Led experimentation and increased PM confidence.

Led the excellent team responsible for [Answers.com](https://www.answers.com). Launched dozens of small-community themed web sites. Launched an expert-contributor platform. Launched an expert-help system.

Introduced project management, built a cost-of-goods-sold model that showed some partners were a drag on the company, and led the Yahoo! and AOL API implementations. Began the move into product with a page redesign that tripled click rate in testing.
Built dozens of systems, including a residuals and participation tracker.
